metadata.nameWarning: VERIFIED means official source cross-reference was researched; not a certification of comprehensive current scheme eligibility

schemes.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Ministry of Education / Department of Higher Education
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Scholarship support for qualifying regular higher-education students.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Merit threshold, household income and other scholarship restrictions apply; detailed 2025–26 FAQ is not proof of 2026–27 rule text.
schemes.sourceEdition: FAQ 2025–26 plus live NSP 2026–27 list
schemes.limitations: Compare 2026–27 specification with FAQ before publishing numerical rule; NSP current listing confirms application deadline.

schemes.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Ministry of Education / Department of School Education
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: School scholarship with selection examination and annual renewal requirements.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: State selection examination, marks, school type and parental-income conditions apply.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Official Oct 31 press note and live NSP page: application deadline 15 Nov 2026 has passed; never show apply-now. Renewal and category relaxation need rule review.

schemes.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: AICTE
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Assistance for eligible female students pursuing approved technical degree courses.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Applicable eligibility depends on approved institutions, year, income, family criteria, and any current amendments.
schemes.sourceEdition: 2026–27 active list; linked PDF may describe 2020–21 edition
schemes.limitations: Historic specification PDF must not be treated as the current 2026–27 governing text.

schemes.title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship (Technical Degree)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: AICTE
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Scholarship support for eligible technical degree students with disabilities.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Disability documentation and approved technical education requirements; current-year details must be confirmed.
schemes.sourceEdition: 2026–27 active list; linked PDF may describe 2020–21 edition
schemes.limitations: Historic specification PDF must not be treated as 2026–27 eligibility authority.

schemes.title: PM YASASVI Top Class Education in College (OBC/EBC/DNT)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Top-class college education support for specified student categories.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Institution, community, income, merit and scholarship conditions apply.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Current governing scheme guidelines, exceptions and required documents must be compared before publication.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Eligible landholding farmer families receive benefit installments under the scheme.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Landholding farmer-family definition and extensive exclusions; Aadhaar and verification requirements apply.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Current official portal and 2026 press note confirm programme; ownership/exclusion rules require guideline-level review.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Seasonal crop insurance for notified crops and areas.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Eligible crop, notified area, season, insurable interest, documents and enrollment cutoff vary; cannot use generic all-India pass/fail rule.
schemes.sourceEdition: 2026 PIB backgrounder; specific state/season notification required
schemes.limitations: State- and season-specific notifications mandatory before eligibility can be checked.

schemes.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Financial Services / Banks
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Credit facility for eligible agricultural and allied activities.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Farm owners, tenant farmers and other eligible agricultural borrowers may apply; lender verifies creditworthiness and documentation.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Credit decision belongs to bank; no automated guarantee or deterministic final eligibility.

schemes.title: Soil Health Card Programme
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Soil test-based nutrient and fertilizer recommendations.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Farmer/soil sample processes and state implementation vary; this is an agricultural service rather than a cash scheme.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Service programme, not monetary benefit; form and eligibility need separate handling.

schemes.title: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) Farmer Registration
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Agricultural marketing platform with registration through an APMC/mandi.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Farmer registration requires KYC, APMC selection and local approval.
schemes.sourceEdition: Public registration guidelines plus 2025 operational guideline
schemes.limitations: Digital service rather than an income-transfer scheme; local/mandi approval applies.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Maternity financial support linked to qualifying conditions for first child and second girl child.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Multiple conditions, beneficiary eligibility groups, pregnancy/child milestones and exclusions require careful rule grouping.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Payment depends on verification and milestones; avoid treating child gender alone as sufficient.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY/Ujjwala 2.0)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: LPG connection support for eligible households.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Adult female applicant, deprivation declaration, no existing LPG connection in household and other conditions.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Official 2026-visible FAQ, KYC, and supplementary 14-point declaration show complex criteria. FAQ contains inconsistent historical category language; obtain governing current order and resolve any contradictions before encoding rules.

schemes.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSA)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: National Savings Institute / Department of Economic Affairs
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Government-backed savings account in the name of an eligible girl child.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Guardian opens account for a girl child below 10; family/account limits and exceptions apply.
schemes.sourceEdition: 2019 scheme rules, 2020 amendment; later amendments to check
schemes.limitations: Specific scheme-rule PDF returned intermittent 502; the official NSI website provides a read-only regulation summary. Current rules and amendments must be rechecked.

schemes.title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: National Health Mission / Ministry of Health
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Conditional maternity support encouraging institutional delivery.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: State category, beneficiary category, place of delivery, and other conditions govern benefit.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Karnataka high-performing-state rules differ from low-performing-state rules; local current circular is necessary.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Ministry of Labour and Employment
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Contributory pension for qualifying unorganised workers; monthly pension after age 60.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Unorganised worker aged 18–40, monthly income threshold, exclusion of EPFO/ESIC/NPS government-funded members and income-tax payers.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Contributory scheme; rules must cover membership exclusions and payment/continuity, not only age and income.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Financial Services
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Low-premium life insurance open to eligible participating account holders.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Account holder age 18–50; joining and eligibility subject to bank/insurer terms.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Cross-category citizen insurance, not exclusively a worker welfare scheme; bank enrollment required.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Financial Services
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Personal accident insurance open to eligible participating account holders.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Account holder age 18–70 with required bank/post-office account and coverage terms.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Cross-category insurance; no automatic approval claim.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Central old-age pension component of renamed national social assistance programme.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Eligibility tied to applicable poverty/BPL and age rules plus state implementation and verification.
schemes.sourceEdition: Programme and sub-scheme renamed 14 October 2026
aliases: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
National Social Assistance Programme old-age pension
schemes.limitations: CRITICAL: IGNOAPS became Pradhan Mantri Vridhavastha Pension Yojana in Oct 2026. Preserve alias and state top-ups. Do not reuse stale pre-2026 labels as current.

schemes.title: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: National Savings Institute / Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Government savings account offering scheme interest subject to current notifications.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Generally 60+ with certain retirement-category exceptions; deposit and account restrictions.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: 2019/2020 NSI rule PDF is outdated in at least its deposit maximum compared with current NSI HTML; never treat its original interest/deposit limits as current. Current bank/post-office guidance required.

schemes.title: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Assistive living devices for qualifying senior citizens with age-related disability/infirmity.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Senior citizen income/eligibility criteria and assessment/camp availability need current official details.
schemes.sourceEdition: Official archive only located; up-to-date operative instructions NOT confirmed
schemes.limitations: ARCHIVE source; do not publish as current active application or encode eligibility without new department source.

schemes.title: Gruha Lakshmi
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Government of Karnataka / Women and Child Development
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: State support for eligible women heads of families.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Current ration-card head status and exclusion conditions need governing order and active portal confirmation.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Karnataka priority candidate. Service portal and fiscal policy reports are NOT authoritative current eligibility notification; do not encode claimed amounts.

schemes.title: Shakti Scheme (Karnataka)
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Government of Karnataka / Transport
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Eligible women and specified beneficiaries can use designated state bus services.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Resident, identity, eligible route/service and exclusions must be verified from transport authority.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Karnataka priority candidate; find current transport department order and permitted bus services before automation.

schemes.title: Yuva Nidhi
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Government of Karnataka
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Conditional support for eligible unemployed graduates and diploma holders.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Qualification, residence, unemployment time-window, enrollment and exceptions must be verified against current state order.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: State news page supports discovery; official operative order and current application process required.

schemes.title: Gruha Jyothi
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Government of Karnataka / Energy
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: Karnataka household electricity-support programme.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Consumer account, residential connection and consumption calculations require exact current energy department order.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: Need department order; do not state flat 200 units eligibility from generic summaries.

schemes.title: Anna Bhagya
schemes.responsibleAuthority: Government of Karnataka / Food and Civil Supplies
schemes.benefitOrServiceSummary: State food security benefit for qualifying ration card beneficiaries.
schemes.eligibilityResearchSummary: Ration card category, benefit delivery and the latest cash/grain arrangement must be verified.
schemes.sourceEdition: Current official webpage consulted; amendments may apply
schemes.limitations: State specifics are subject to delivery changes; confirm current operative entitlement before publication.
